title: Langzaam maar zeker: Dutch from the first sentence
description: 45 short Dutch lessons for English speakers: first ready-made phrases for the shop, work and the town hall, then the grammar.

config.title: Dutch *from the first sentence*
config.subtitle: 45 short lessons for English speakers in the Netherlands. First ready-made phrases for the shop, work and the town hall, then the grammar. Listen, repeat and speak aloud.

items.title: Listen
items.markdown: You can play every sentence at normal speed and slowly, as often as you like.

items.title: Speak aloud
items.markdown: In the “say it” exercises the browser listens and checks what you say.

items.title: Phrases first
items.markdown: Grammar comes later: at most one new rule per lesson.

items.title: Phase 0: To begin with
items.markdown: Dit, dat, heeft u…: getting by in a shop with a few words. Lessons 1–5.

items.title: Phase 1: The basic verbs
items.markdown: To be, to have, to want, can, to go, to come. Lessons 6–12.

items.title: Phase 2: Where and where to
items.markdown: Prepositions, asking the way, at the station. Lessons 13–20.

items.title: Phase 3: What you do
items.markdown: Regular verbs and the past. Lessons 21–30.

items.title: Phase 4: Describing
items.markdown: Colours, comparing, the weather, the time, the days, making an appointment. Lessons 31–40.

items.title: Phase 5: Polite and precise
items.markdown: Zou graag, omdat, als… dan: polite requests and longer sentences. Lessons 41–45.

config.markdown: **You do not need an account.** All lessons work without one. With an account your results are also there on another phone or computer. [Create an account](/en/account/register)
